Metadata.defaultTitle: Palácio Doce | Artisan Pastry & Sweets in Braga
Metadata.defaultDescription: Artisan pastry, sweets and desserts in Braga. Order cakes, sweets and gift boxes online, with delivery or in-store pickup.

Home.heroSubheadline: Discover the flavours of Palácio Doce. Pastries, sweets and desserts created to make every moment a little more special.
Home.featuredSubtitle: A selection of Palácio Doce's most requested creations
Home.aboutTeaserTitle: Made with Care, Served with Love
Home.aboutTeaserBody: In the heart of Braga, Palácio Doce blends traditional Portuguese pastry techniques with a contemporary touch. Every sweet is prepared daily, with carefully selected ingredients and close attention to detail.
Home.deliveryTitle: Delivery in Braga or In-Store Pickup
Home.deliveryBody: Choose home delivery within the Braga area or pickup at our pastry shop on R. de Santa Margarida.
Home.newsletterBody: Get a first look at new sweets and special offers.
Home.highlightLocal: Delivery in Braga or in-store pickup
Home.seoIntroTitle: Pastry Shop in Braga with Home Delivery
Home.seoIntroBody: Palácio Doce is an online pastry shop in Braga, specialising in artisan cakes, sweets and desserts. Order online and have it delivered to your door, or pick it up at our shop on R. de Santa Margarida.

About.title: About Us
About.heroTitle: The Sweetness of Braga, Since Always
About.heroBody: Palácio Doce was born from a passion for traditional Portuguese pastry, paired with a contemporary eye for flavour and presentation.
About.storyBody: Located on R. de Santa Margarida, in the heart of Braga, we dedicate ourselves daily to creating sweets, cakes and desserts with carefully selected ingredients. Every recipe is designed to bring comfort and celebration to our customers' most special moments.
About.valueQualityBody: Daily production, no shortcuts, with fresh, quality ingredients.
About.valueCraftBody: From recipe to final presentation, we treat every sweet as a small work of craft.
About.valueCommunityBody: Proudly serving the Braga community, with local delivery and in-store pickup.
About.ctaBody: Discover our shop and order your favourite sweets.
